presenterOverlay.beforeDescription: OpenScreen records your camera separately for editing. macOS Presenter Overlay can interrupt that recording. Use OpenScreen’s camera overlay instead.
presenterOverlay.interruptedDescription: macOS Presenter Overlay was enabled during this take and may have interrupted the separate camera track. Turn it off and start a fresh take if you need an editable camera recording.
presenterOverlay.screenOnlyTitle: Presenter Overlay is in the screen video
presenterOverlay.screenOnlyDescription: Your camera is not being recorded as a separate track. The system overlay is included in the screen video and cannot be edited independently.
